moments.title: Shawn Mendes Turns 28
moments.blurb: Canadian pop sensation Shawn Mendes celebrates his 28th birthday today, known for hits like 'Stitches' and 'Señorita'.

angles.name: Birthday Shoutout
angles.copy: Happy 28th Birthday to Shawn Mendes today! What's your favourite track from the Canadian superstar?

angles.name: Career Highlight
angles.copy: From Vine star to global pop icon, Shawn Mendes is 28 today. Still can't get 'Stitches' out of our heads!

moments.title: Rebellion Festival Wraps Up
moments.blurb: The iconic Rebellion Festival, a four-day celebration of punk and alternative music, concludes today in Blackpool.

angles.name: Last Day Buzz
angles.copy: Final day for the punk faithful at Rebellion Festival in Blackpool! Who's been there and still has a voice?

angles.name: Festival Vibe
angles.copy: Blackpool's been taken over by punk rock for the last four days as Rebellion Festival wraps up. What a weekend!

moments.title: Roots Picnic UK Kicks Off
moments.blurb: The globally celebrated hip hop festival, Roots Picnic, makes its international debut today at Crystal Palace Bowl in London.

angles.name: London Debut
angles.copy: History in the making! Roots Picnic UK kicks off its international debut at Crystal Palace Bowl today. Who's heading down?

angles.name: Hip Hop & Culture
angles.copy: London's Crystal Palace Bowl hosts the first ever Roots Picnic UK this weekend! Expect a blend of world-class hip hop and culture.

moments.title: Edinburgh Fringe in Full Swing
moments.blurb: The world's largest arts festival, Edinburgh Fringe, continues its three-week run of comedy, theatre, music, and dance across the city.

angles.name: Festival Buzz
angles.copy: Edinburgh is absolutely buzzing! The Fringe Festival is in full swing with thousands of shows to explore. What's on your must-see list?

angles.name: Cultural Highlight
angles.copy: Comedy, theatre, music, and more! The Edinburgh Fringe Festival is delivering three weeks of incredible arts and culture right now.

moments.title: Royal Edinburgh Military Tattoo
moments.blurb: The Royal Edinburgh Military Tattoo continues its spectacular performances on the esplanade of Edinburgh Castle, running until August 29th.

angles.name: Spectacle & Tradition
angles.copy: The Royal Edinburgh Military Tattoo is lighting up the castle esplanade! A truly unmissable spectacle of music and tradition.

angles.name: A Call to Gather
angles.copy: Under the theme 'A Call to Gather', the Royal Edinburgh Military Tattoo is captivating audiences with pipes, drums, and military displays.

moments.title: Palace Bowl Presents Series
moments.blurb: The 'Palace Bowl Presents' festival series continues at Crystal Palace Bowl in London with an eclectic lineup of global headliners until August 16th.

angles.name: London Live Music
angles.copy: More amazing live music at Crystal Palace Bowl with the 'Palace Bowl Presents' series running until next week! Who are you hoping to catch?

angles.name: Summer Gigs
angles.copy: Crystal Palace Bowl is buzzing all summer long! The 'Palace Bowl Presents' series has brought some incredible artists to London.

moments.title: Mark Knopfler's 77th Birthday
moments.blurb: Dire Straits frontman Mark Knopfler will celebrate his 77th birthday on August 12th.

angles.name: Upcoming Birthday
angles.copy: Get ready to celebrate a legend! Mark Knopfler of Dire Straits turns 77 on August 12th. What's your favourite Dire Straits track?

angles.name: Guitar Hero
angles.copy: The distinctive guitar work of Mark Knopfler has graced our airwaves for decades. He celebrates his 77th birthday this Wednesday!

moments.title: Joe Jonas Turns 37
moments.blurb: Jonas Brothers and DNCE singer Joe Jonas will celebrate his 37th birthday on August 15th.

angles.name: Birthday Countdown
angles.copy: Counting down to Joe Jonas's 37th birthday on August 15th! What's your favourite Jonas Brothers or DNCE hit?

angles.name: Pop Star Milestone
angles.copy: From Camp Rock to DNCE, Joe Jonas has given us so many bops. He turns 37 this Saturday!

moments.title: UK Summer School Holidays
moments.blurb: Summer school holidays are in full swing across the UK, with many families enjoying their breaks before schools return in mid-August (Scotland) or early September (England/Wales/NI).

angles.name: Holiday Vibes
angles.copy: Summer holidays are well underway across the UK! What have you been up to, or what are your plans for the rest of the break?

angles.name: Local School Break
angles.copy: Devon families, how are you making the most of the summer school holidays? Don't forget school returns early September for most!

moments.title: All Points East Approaches
moments.blurb: London's Victoria Park prepares for All Points East Festival, taking place from August 21st to 30th with headliners like Tyler, The Creator and Lorde.

angles.name: Festival Countdown
angles.copy: All Points East is just around the corner! Who are you most excited to see at Victoria Park from August 21-30?

angles.name: Diverse Lineup
angles.copy: From Tyler, The Creator to Lorde, All Points East has an incredible lineup this year. Get ready for 10 days of music in London!

moments.title: Creamfields Festival Nears
moments.blurb: The UK's largest electronic music festival, Creamfields, is set to take place in Daresbury, Cheshire, from August 27th to 30th.

angles.name: Dance Music Anticipation
angles.copy: Creamfields is just weeks away! Get ready for four days of the biggest names in electronic music in Cheshire.

angles.name: Festival Prep
angles.copy: Who's already planning their Creamfields outfits? The UK's biggest electronic music festival returns late August!
